author: Alva palva päron halva

title: The recent update has worsened the app.
body: The app often glitches and flips your screen when you open it after having had it run in the background, tasks end without giving you any notification or even warning that the app has closed itself in the background and you may not be able to hear the notifications. The white noise doesn’t always turn on when you try to turn it on, it sometimes adds extra time to your tasks on its own. I have had routinery for over a year now, and before it wasn’t perfect,  but it was manageable;  now it’s almost unusable. I was waiting for an update hoping there would be positive improvements but instead we got an app that can’t even perform its most basic function. I am deeply disappointed, perhaps this kind of app just isn’t compatible with IOS, idk. My routines have been affected too much by Routinery, and I will now be deleting the app.

The app works great and I love the features that I already have but I have a few ideas that I would love to be added:

title: My app won’t start
body:
I love the idea of this app, and gladly payed for the full version which allows me to have multiple routines. The features are great! That being said, there are definetely some bugs.
The app won’t sync between my apple watch and phone when in the middle of a routine, it won’t update in the morning and show todays routines on my watch unless I first open the app in my phone etc. 

These are things I can live with, but simce yesterday morning I have a huge problem:

My app won’t start. It just loads and loads and I can never get in. All my other apps work fine so its not a connection issue, and i have tried restarting my phone and the app. I’m scared to delete the app and download it again because I don’t want the routines I’ve set up to dissapear.

Not sure how to fix this since support keeps sending me to app which won’t start. Please help?
author: Lovinda96

title: Love the idea, but Apple Watch integration is broken.
body:
First off, Routinery is THE app I have been looking for to execute and stick to a good morning and evening routine. When I wake up I want to start the routine from my Apple Watch, but this becomes problemtic. Lots of strange bugs with the Apple Watch app:

- Timer does not always update and you need to swipe left and right to refresh it. 
- It does not always notify you at the end kf a routine step, making you go over time unintentinally.
- It does not sync properly with Iphone app during and after a routine.

I’m sure Im not the only one who wants to use Apple Watch app as the main driver for routines. So hope it can be prioritized in the development. Thanks so much!
